label: AMD EPYC 9354P (Zen 4, 32C/64T, 1 socket, NPS4) — CloudLab r6615 (Clemson)
_note: max_mem_gb omitted: detected at sweep time (CPU MemTotal/sockets*0.8). Placements resolving to the same CPU set and scaling counts >= the socket's cores are dropped automatically.

derivation.bandwidth: 12 channels x DDR5-4800 x 8 B = 460.8 GB/s (dmidecode on clnode330: 12x16 GB, configured 4800 MT/s)
derivation.compute: 32 cores x 3.25 GHz base x 16 FP64 FLOP/cycle (Zen 4: 2x 256-bit FMA pipes; AVX-512 double-pumped) = 1664; fp32 = 2x. Boost clocks are NOT used for the datasheet figure.
